title: ETL Schema Validation Failure
description: The input data schema does not match the expected pipeline schema.
diagnostic_steps: Inspect the latest pipeline execution logs.
Identify missing fields or incompatible data types.
Test the corrected schema on a sample dataset.

title: ML Inference High Latency
description: The ML inference service has unusually high response times.
diagnostic_steps: Inspect average latency and P95 latency.
Check the number of concurrent requests.
Compare latency against the reference baseline.

title: Data Quality: Missing Values
description: The incoming dataset contains unexpected missing values.
diagnostic_steps: Calculate the missing-value rate for each feature.
Compare the rates with the reference dataset.
Identify recent changes in upstream data sources.
Review the preprocessing and imputation rules.
Escalate if the missing values affect critical features.
